title: Decoder-Side Semantic Conditioning for Low-Bitrate Neural Speech Compression
abstract: arXiv:2512.21653v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Speech codecs are usually optimized for waveform fidelity, allocating bits to acoustic detail that can be inferred from linguistic structure. This leads to inefficient compression and degraded recognition performance. We propose SemDAC, a semantic-aware neural speech codec that adds hierarchical semantic conditioning to residual vector quantization (RVQ). The first RVQ quantizer is distilled from HuBERT features to produce semantic tokens capturing phonetic content, while later quantizers encode residual acoustics. The decoder is conditioned on semantic tokens via feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), steering reconstruction toward information not explained by semantic abstraction. At 0.95 kbps, SemDAC matches or surpasses a 2.5 kbps DAC baseline on PESQ, STOI, SI-SNR, and Whisper WER, with comparable ViSQOL, and achieves higher subjective MOS than higher-bitrate DAC baselines. translated_title: 面向低比特率神经语音压缩的解码端语义条件化方法
translated_abstract: 语音编解码器通常以波形保真度为优化目标，将比特分配给那些可以从语言结构中推断出来的声学细节，这导致了压缩效率低下和识别性能下降。我们提出了SemDAC，一种语义感知的神经语音编解码器，它在残差向量量化（RVQ）中引入了层次化的语义条件化机制。第一个RVQ量化器从HuBERT特征蒸馏而来，产生能够捕捉语音内容的语义标记，而后续的量化器则编码残余的声学信息。解码器通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）以语义标记为条件，将重建过程引导至语义抽象未能解释的信息上。在0.95 kbps的比特率下，SemDAC在PESQ、STOI、SI-SNR和Whisper WER指标上达到或超越了2.5 kbps的DAC基线，ViSQOL表现相当，并且其主观MOS高于更高比特率的DAC基线。结果表明，显式的语义条件化……
tldr: SemDAC通过在残差向量量化中引入由HuBERT蒸馏得到的语义条件化机制，使语音编解码器在仅0.95 kbps的比特率下即可达到甚至超越2.5 kbps DAC基线的客观与主观性能。
en_tdlr: SemDAC introduces HuBERT-distilled semantic conditioning into residual vector quantization, enabling a neural speech codec to match or exceed a 2.5 kbps DAC baseline at only 0.95 kbps in both objective metrics and subjective quality.
